newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel Bank proposes 52 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Bank proposes 52 mln new shares.

text.p: Keppel Bank of Singapore Ltd said on Wednesday it is proposing to issue 52 million new ordinary shares of Singapore $1.00 each in the capital of the bank at S$3.98 per share.
Keppel said in a statement the new shares will be privately placed with investors. It said the net proceeds from the issue will be used to increase the bank's working capital.
Robert Fleming & Co Ltd, JM Sassoon & Co (Pte) Ltd and Tsang & Ong Stockbrokers (Pte) Ltd have been appointed as placement agents to subscribe or procure subscriptions for the new shares.
Keppel said the net tangible assets per share would increase by about 15 cents each.
The bank had requested a trading suspension of its shares, warrants and bonds on Wednesday, pending an announcement.
The shares ended at S$4.02 on Tuesday.
